Standing briefing — tetrix-game-monorepo, week of 2026-07-26

Master is green and the deploy queue is empty, so there is no firefight this week. If something must be built, take the item below and nothing else.

If something must be built, do the invited-visitor arm split. visitor_events carries no arm today, so an invited visitor cannot be told apart from an organic one in the arrival funnel. Assign the arm at arrival only, leave it nullable for rows that predate the change, derive it from the visitor id so it is stable without a lookup, keep the whole thing behind a default-off knob, and give the admin read a per-arm breakdown.

Not this week: the lobby reconnect timeout is still wrong on flaky mobile networks, and it already has an owner. Leave it alone.

Not this week either: the seed script for local Postgres is slow enough to be irritating. It is irritating rather than blocking, and rewriting it is worth doing only once the funnel question above is answered.
